# SKILL BHARAT Education

Official website: https://bharatskill48-sketch.github.io/skill-bharat-education/

SKILL BHARAT Education is an online vocational learning and student-services platform.

## Learning areas
- Electrician: electrical theory, wiring basics and safety.
- Mobile Repairing: mobile hardware, tools and troubleshooting.
- Computer Science: computer fundamentals, software and programming.
- AC Technician: air-conditioning basics and safe maintenance.
- General Trade & Employability: workshop safety, tools and job readiness.

## Student services
- Student registration and login.
- Online admission applications.
- Trade-wise study materials.
- Student dashboard and digital student ID card features.
- Certificate applications subject to administrator review.
- Certificate ID search and verification.

## Contact
- Email: bharatskill48@gmail.com

## Accuracy
Use the official website for current course availability, admission requirements and certificate status. Do not assume government affiliation, accreditation or licensing unless independently supported by published evidence.
